result_summary.title: Mobile App white screen of death and form submission failures in US-West dev
result_summary.description: Our development team in US-West is encountering severe issues with the Mobile App. Users are frequently experiencing a white screen of death upon launch or after navigating between screens. When the app does load, key UI elements fail to render correctly, and forms are unable to submit data to the backend. This instability is affecting 7,155 users in the development environment and is currently blocking our sprint deliverables, resulting in a critical business impact.
